file_impact.reason: Shared engine function mapping a changed-file set to the criterion ids whose rubric files it touches.
Expose the selection as `rebar criteria eval --changed-since <ref>`, calling the shared engine function rather than reimplementing the mapping.
Add the change-triggered job as a thin caller, and keep the new specs out of the weekly live sweep's resolved list.
Subprocess tests over seeded temporary git repositories for the selection, the empty case, the unmappable rubric path and the no-CI-environment case.
Make the `criteria eval` positional criterion_id OPTIONAL and mutually exclusive with the new `--changed-since <ref>` flag; neither given still yields exit 2, preserving the documented contract.

Update the `criteria` row to document the `--changed-since` selection mode: prints selected ids and exits 0; an unmappable rubric path is named on stderr and still exits 0; empty/missing id (neither form) still exits 2.
Register the new non-blocking eval-changed-rubrics ci_gate job (from prompt-eval.yml) in the mechanism baseline so the mechanism-delta ratchet passes.
Exclude the new non-blocking (continue-on-error) eval-changed-rubrics job from the Verified-vote parity gate so it cannot redden main.
